title: Remove processed-timestamp series when partition ownership ends
answers: Why does IngestionAnalyticsSinglePartitionDelayed page for a partition that is not behind?
Why does an ingestion pod still report a partition after a rebalance?
How should processed-timestamp metrics handle revoked partitions?
body:
Symptom: IngestionAnalyticsSinglePartitionDelayed can page for a partition that is not behind after a rebalance.
Root cause: nodejs/src/ingestion/ingestion-consumer.ts:latestOffsetTimestampGauge retains the former owner's latest_processed_timestamp_ms series; its stale timestamp ages while an idle new owner may export no series.
Fix pattern: Register partition cleanup through KafkaConsumerInterface.connect; nodejs/src/ingestion/ingestion-consumer.ts:IngestionConsumer.onPartitionsRevoked removes each revoked series using topic, partition and groupId, preserving retained partitions' series.
Constraints: Applies to this analytics processed-timestamp gauge. Remove series rather than resetting the whole gauge. A new owner stalled before processing has no series, so this single-partition alert cannot detect that case; all-partitions and stopped-consuming alerts still cover a stalled lane.
applies: Analytics ingestion partition ownership changes and latest_processed_timestamp_ms metric lifecycle.
